as_told.title: Parsons recites the Hymn to Pan at rocket tests

plain: Jack Parsons, whom Michels calls the godfather of American rocketry and a founder of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, is said to have recited the Hymn to Pan, a poem by the English occultist Aleister Crowley, at his rocket tests. Michels tells it himself on two episodes, without naming a source. The first time he says Parsons did it before every test. The second time he says Parsons did it only sometimes, during the tests. Either way, it puts occult ritual at the birth of American rocket science.
